Method of Attack: Linux encryptor targeting and encrypting VMware ESXi virtual machines and NAS devices
Runs esxcli command line tool to list and terminate running ESXi VMs to close VMDK files before encryption
Encrypts virtual machine disk files stored in /vmfs/ folder
Uses silent mode and multi-threading (default 50 threads) for encryption
Indicators of Compromise: File hashes collected by Jaime Blasco and shared on Alienvault's Open Threat Exchange
esxcli --formatter=csv --format-param=fields=="WorldID,DisplayName" vm process list | awk -F ""*","*" '{system("esxcli vm process kill --type=force --world-id=" $1)}'
